question: Should this PR become the canonical Neuralwatt landing branch, replacing the conflicted earlier implementation once its findings and exact-head proof gate are resolved?
rationale: Both pull requests implement the same provider, but neither currently supplies a merge-ready combination of clean integration, resolved presentation behavior, and exact-head live proof; maintainers should prevent parallel branches from diverging further.

options.title: Canonicalize this PR
options.body: Fix the two presentation defects, obtain exact-head redacted live proof, and use this cleanly mergeable branch as the landing candidate.

options.title: Return to the earlier branch
options.body: Rebase https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760, port the newer subscription and presentation work, and obtain proof for that resulting head.

options.title: Pause Neuralwatt integration
options.body: Keep both branches unmerged until a maintainer or contributor with authorized credentials can validate the desired provider contract end to end.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize this PR
recommendation.body: Fix the two presentation defects, obtain exact-head redacted live proof, and use this cleanly mergeable branch as the landing candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored most of the provider hardening and current-main integration work and are best positioned to designate the canonical branch.
